head_coach.name: Rudi Garcia
head_coach.play_style_summary: An attacking, high-tempo, possession-based style focused on rapid vertical transitions immediately after winning the ball. Employs aggressive pressing without the ball and encourages fluidity from attacking midfielders and wingers to stretch opposition lines.

key_players.name: Jérémy Doku
key_players.performance_stats: Regarded as one of Belgium's premier attacking outlets, utilizing explosive dribbling and rapid pace to stretch defenses. He was a central figure during their unbeaten World Cup qualifying campaign.

key_players.name: Youri Tielemans
key_players.performance_stats: Serves as the national team captain. He controls the tempo from central midfield, providing defensive coverage and driving ball progression into the final third.

key_players.name: Charles De Ketelaere
key_players.performance_stats: Highly versatile creative midfielder who excels at finding pockets of space and linking play between the midfield and lone striker. He started in Belgium's key World Cup warm-up matches.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined while recovering from a hip injury.
Excluded from the World Cup squad due to a lack of playing time after spending several months on the bench at club level.
